data.explanation: This is your insurance policy document (Versicherungsschein). Cover starts on 1 October 2026 for a one-year term. The contract renews by one year each time unless you cancel in text form at least three months before the end of the insurance year. The first premium is collected by direct debit at the start, so make sure your account has enough money. Check that the details are correct and keep the policy.
